question: Which book written by Douglas Stuart won him the Booker Prize 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shuggie Bain.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Douglas Stuart**__

 __
 
• He is a Scottish-American writer and fashion designer.
 
• Shuggie Bain is his debut novel, which was awarded the 2020 Booker Prize.
 
 
 
• **Booker Prize**__
 __
 
• It is a literary award given for novels written in English and Published in either England or Ireland.
 
• The Prize was constituted in the year 1969 by Booker McConnell Limited Company.
 
• The First winner of this prize was PH Newby who won it for his novel 'Something to Answer for'.
 
• The awardee is presented with a reward of 50,000 Euros.
 
 
 
• **Shuggie Bain**__
 __
 
• It is an autobiographical novel that tells the story of his mother and him and is set in Glasgow in the 1980s.
 
• The novel tells us about a boy supporting her mother suffering from alcoholism, marriage breakdown and poverty.
 
• The novel was rejected by 32 publishers before being published by UK based Picador Publishers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian winners of Booker Prize**__

• Salman Rushdie: Midnight's Children 
 
• Arundhati Roy: The god of small things
